messages.subject: Okafor v Ashbourne Healthcare (2204417/2025) — Schedule of Loss
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

Please find served herewith our client's Schedule of Loss. As you will see, the claim is pleaded at £191,062, reflecting past and future loss, injury to feelings in the middle Vento band for the s.47B detriment, and a 25% uplift for your client's failure to follow the Acas Code. We have reserved our client's position on aggravated damages.

Given the uncapped nature of the principal claims, our client invites your client to consider its position. We are open to a without-prejudice discussion.

Kind regards,
Rachel Hartley
Birchall Stone LLP

messages.subject: RE: Okafor v Ashbourne Healthcare (2204417/2025) — Schedule of Loss
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Hartley,

Thank you. We have your schedule and will respond on quantum in due course; we do not accept it, in particular the future-loss period and the uplift, the latter being misconceived given the consultation process that was followed. Liability remains firmly denied.

That said, our client is prepared to explore whether this matter can be resolved commercially and we will revert with any without-prejudice proposal separately.

Kind regards,
Sarah Whitfield
